pr_title: Fix audio track end and start offset editing
pr_body: Fixes #68788. Both start and end offset dragging is now possible with proper preview of the changes

issue_context.title: Audio Playback Track Offset broken
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0 beta5

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

The Audio Playback Track in the Animation Player appears to be broken when using offsets. You can drag from the end of the track to add an End Offset, dragging from the start does not work at all. But when you add an End Offset, then selecting the track does not work anymore and it displays the error message:
`scene/resources/animation.cpp:3696 - Index p_key = -1 is out of bounds (at->values.size() = 1).`
No more changes to the track can be applied, until you reload the scene.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create an Animation Player and an AudioStreamPlayer. Add an animation and an AudioPlaybackTrack
- Drag an Audio File into the AudioPlaybackTrack
- Manipulate start end end of the track 

### Minimal reproduction project

[BrokenAudioAnimationPlayer.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/10032057/BrokenAudioAnimationPlayer.zip)
